metadata.affiliation_rule: Every author affiliation index resolves to one uniquely indexed, non-empty affiliation with its verified ROR identifier.

word_count.unit: body words after YAML front matter, including headings and figure descriptions

requirements: Explain the research decision and the software purpose for a diverse non-specialist audience.
State what users supply and what the software returns.
Define unavoidable abbreviations at first use.
Report one concrete result without promotional language.
State the research problem and the practical consequence of leaving it unsolved.
Identify the target audience and intended research contexts.
State the implemented contribution rather than a hypothetical benefit.
Compare the software with commonly used packages and services.
Describe specific strengths of alternatives and specific boundaries of voiage.
Provide a defensible build-versus-contribute justification.
Cite every comparative or methodological claim.
Explain the chosen architecture, alternatives or trade-offs, and why they matter for research.
Describe the Rust, Python, R, and Julia boundaries exactly as implemented.
Explain scientific maturity and verification without reproducing API documentation.
Declare the decision model, study model, assumptions, and synthetic-data boundary.
Report interpretable EVPI, EVPPI, EVSI, and ENBS results.
Distinguish Monte Carlo error, model uncertainty, and sensitivity scenarios.
Link the figure and machine-readable data to a deterministic reproduction record.
Give the figure a stable identifier and cross-reference it in the text.
Provide concrete realised impact or reproducible evidence of credible near-term significance.
Do not present same-author work, automated checks, or aspirations as independent adoption.
State missing external engagement evidence plainly.
Identify systems and best-available versions and where each was used.
Describe the scope of assistance.
Record human primary decision-making, review, modification, validation, and accountability.
Do not invent unavailable historical model identifiers.
State funding and competing interests.
Identify the exact reviewed software version, release, immutable archive, and synthetic data.
Bind the reproduction manifest to the reviewed revision.
Do not use prospective release or archive language in a submission candidate.
Resolve every in-text citation to one complete bibliography record and leave no record uncited.

prohibited_content: full mathematical derivation already available in supporting material
prospective release or archive claims in the submission candidate

external: demonstrated research use, at minimum by the developer
community engagement or collaborative input as a detailed-review criterion and strong positive pre-review signal
JOSS editorial screening, review, and acceptance
project_sequence: pyOpenSci first, then eligible JOSS partner handling; arXiv deferred until journal submission and later authorized action per maintainer decision on 2026-08-31

human_only_certifications: human review, modification, and validation of all retained AI-assisted outputs
external community engagement or research use
submission and responses to JOSS editors or reviewers
